sourceNotes: Summarized from SKF bearing selection process and common rolling bearing engineering practice.
selectionFlow: Define radial load, axial load, speed, duty cycle, and environment.
Select bearing type by load direction and misalignment tolerance.
Estimate equivalent dynamic load and required rating life.
Check limiting speed, lubrication method, sealing, fits, and mounting space.
Document bearing designation and installation constraints.

avoidWhen: very high speed without thermal design

useWhen: shaft deflection or mounting misalignment is expected
avoidWhen: high positioning accuracy is required without additional constraints
